question: If ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral with angle A = 3x°, angle B = 5x°, angle C = 9y° and angle D = 2y°, then y/x is
solution:
**Concept Used:****
In Cyclic Quadrilateral sum of opposite angles is 180o

Calculation:**

Here, A and C are opposite angles and B and D are also opposite angles.

⇒ 3x + 9y = 180o . . .(i)

⇒ 5x + 2y = 180o . . .(ii)

equation (i) × 5 - equation (ii) × 3

⇒ 45y - 6y = 900 - 540 

⇒ 39y = 360o

⇒ y = 120/13

In equation (ii),

⇒ 5x = 180 - 240/13 = (180×13 - 240)/13 = (2340 - 240)/13 = 2100/13

⇒ x = 420/13

⇒ x/y = 420/120 = 42/12 = 21/6 = 7/2

**Hence, y/x is 2/7.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

Here, A and C are opposite angles and B and D are also opposite angles.

⇒ 3x + 9y = 180o . . .(i)

⇒ 5x + 2y = 180o . . .(ii)

From equation (I) and (II),

3x + 9y = 5x + 2y

⇒ 9y - 2y = 5x - 3x

⇒ 7y = 2x

⇒ y/x = 2/7

Hence, y/x is 2/7.
